clauses.clause: Panic spreads: a calm ped seeing running peds panics; no ped stays unaffected next to the chaos.
clauses.note: All16 current low/high WebGL2 frames personally inspected at actual zoom0.5/1.5 and ticks30/60/120/600. A controlled production panic stimulus affects one existing bench civilian only; other civilians are untouched. Bench neighbors visibly rise and move away, leaving benches empty by10s; no permanently unaffected seated neighbor in the reviewed clear-sight cases. Independent fresh native production sight-cone+LOS+speed fixture observes6 qualifying neighbors per tier across four runner cases; all react in1–5ticks, within the6tick perception poll. No invented actors, infected, gunfire or alarm stimulus. This isolates propagation; it is not an unassisted player-route claim.
